skill.name: youtube-transcript-analysis-api-skill
skill.description: Extract YouTube transcripts with the BrowserAct API and turn them into concise competitive content analysis across hooks, audience, pain points, CTAs, and gaps.
skill.summary: Extract YouTube transcripts with BrowserAct and analyze video strategy across messaging, audience, CTAs, and content gaps.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or malware intent was found in the reviewed files. Confirmed risks are the expected BrowserAct network dependency, local script invocation, sensitive API-key handling, and a high-risk instruction that encourages users to provide the key in chat.

remediation.issue: The skill asks users to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY when it is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to configure BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment secret, and never ask them to paste raw API keys into chat.

remediation.issue: User URLs, keywords, and workflow parameters are sent to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Document the third-party data flow clearly and ask for confirmation before sending sensitive research terms or private URLs.

remediation.issue: The skill runs a local Python script with user-controlled arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Validate that single-mode targets are YouTube URLs and keep batch limits within a documented safe range.

content.value_statement: YouTube competitor research takes hours when transcripts and messaging must be reviewed manually. This skill extracts transcripts through BrowserAct and guides concise analysis of positioning, audiences, hooks, CTAs, and gaps.
actual_capabilities: Runs single-video transcript extraction for a provided YouTube URL.
Runs batch transcript extraction from YouTube search keywords, upload date, and result limit.
Uses the BrowserAct workflow API to retrieve video metadata and transcript output.
Polls workflow status and retrieves completed task results.
Guides analysis across hooks, messaging, audience, pain points, evidence, CTAs, and content gaps.
Provides retry guidance for invalid keys, concurrency limits, and failed extraction tasks.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key in the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.
Sends target URLs, keywords, and workflow parameters to the BrowserAct API.
Transcript quality depends on video captions and BrowserAct workflow results.
Cannot analyze unavailable, private, or restricted videos unless BrowserAct can access them.

use_cases.title: Benchmark competitor videos
use_cases.description: Compare hooks, value propositions, CTAs, and content gaps across recent competitor videos.

use_cases.title: Map audience pain points
use_cases.description: Extract stated problems, viewer intent, and recurring language from videos in a product category.

use_cases.title: Plan differentiated content
use_cases.description: Find missing topics and weak arguments that can shape stronger future video scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this YouTube video with the transcript skill: <video URL>. Focus on hook, audience, core message, CTA, and gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare recent niche videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Search YouTube for <keyword>, upload date <date range>, limit <number>. Compare positioning, pain points, CTAs, and missing topics.

prompt_templates.title: Extract audience signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the transcript skill on <video URL>. Identify target viewer level, intent, pain points, emotional arc, and exact phrases worth reusing.

prompt_templates.title: Build a competitive content map
prompt_templates.prompt: Run batch analysis for <keyword> with limit <number>. Create a concise map of hooks, business models, proof, CTAs, and whitespace opportunities.

output_examples.output: A metadata summary followed by concise bullets for hook, thesis, audience, pain points, proof, CTA, and three content gaps.

output_examples.input: Batch search for recent SaaS onboarding videos
output_examples.output: Individual video summaries plus a comparison of shared value propositions, recurring objections, CTA patterns, and underused angles.

output_examples.input: Audience research request for a tutorial video
output_examples.output: A focused profile of viewer intent, assumed knowledge, emotional shifts, terminology level, and product questions left unanswered.

best_practices: Configure the BrowserAct key as an environment secret before invoking the skill.
Use narrow keywords, recent upload filters, and small batch limits for clearer comparisons.
State the analysis focus so the final report emphasizes the most useful dimensions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste raw API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not run broad batch searches without a clear date range and result limit.
Do not publish full raw transcripts when the user asked for strategic insights.

faq.question: Does this skill require BrowserAct?
faq.answer: Yes. It runs BrowserAct workflow templates and requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be configured.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Batch mode searches by keyword, upload date, and result limit, then compares the extracted videos.

faq.question: Does it show the full transcript?
faq.answer: The skill asks the agent to use transcripts internally and present concise analysis instead of full raw text.

faq.question: What data is sent externally?
faq.answer: The BrowserAct API receives the URL or search terms, workflow parameters, and the API key as authorization.

faq.question: Can it work without captions?
faq.answer: Results depend on the captions or transcript data that BrowserAct can extract from the video.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
